_comment: Template. Copy to keys.free.json (drop SOPHTRON_* and SWIPEWISE_PRO) and keys.pro.json (keep everything). Both are gitignored via keys*.json. There are no build flavors: one binary, and the keys file decides which tier a local build behaves as. The PUBLISHED release must be built from keys.free.json — building it from keys.pro.json yields a working APK containing every credential, which is exactly what tool/verify_release_apk.py exists to catch.
_comment_cert: SHA-1 of the cert THIS build is signed with, sent as X-Android-Cert. Debug builds: the debug keystore's SHA-1. The Play build: the APP SIGNING SHA-1 from Play Console -> Setup -> App signing, NOT the upload cert. Wrong value = Places rejects every request and the Stores tab is silently empty, in production only.
